entities.name: Tadeusz Kasprzycki
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tadeusz Adam Kasprzycki was a member of the Polish Legions in First World War, major general of the Polish Armed Forces from 1929 and Minister of Military Affairs of Poland from 1935 to 1939. He commanded the 12th Infantry Division from 1927 to 1931.
